title: Miles with TRTLLM BF16

excluded_attempts.reason: GPU0 uncorrectable ECC; Slurm drained the node and requested reboot. Archived separately; the replacement restarts from the initial policy.
Unretried worker-discovery HTTP transport failure after generation; no recoverable checkpoint. Archived separately. r2 restarts from the initial model with bounded discovery GET retries.

software_note: GB300 uses an upstream Miles base with the scoped TRTLLM weight-refit fixes. Rubin uses the CUDA13.4/TE2.19 adaptation. Software stacks differ; these are comparisons of the recorded systems.
runtime_note: Rubin r2 adds bounded transport retries only for worker-discovery GETs. Launcher, learning recipe, generation POSTs, numerical kernels and graph settings are unchanged.
